subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should this land with fail-closed rejection of LID-form allowlist entries after rebasing, or must an upgrade diagnostic be added before merge?
rationale: The safer authorization rule is intentional and technically coherent, but only the WhatsApp owners can decide whether silently disabling previously accepted LID-form operator entries is an acceptable upgrade outcome.

options.title: Keep fail-closed with diagnostics
options.body: Preserve strict PN/LID separation, add a focused doctor or setup warning for rejected legacy LID-form allowlist entries, then rebase and validate the exact head.

options.title: Accept the compatibility break
options.body: Land the strict behavior after rebase and live validation, explicitly accepting that affected operators must replace unsafe LID-form allowlist entries manually.

options.title: Pause and narrow
options.body: Separate hosted-JID canonicalization from the approval and allowlist policy change if owners are not ready to decide the upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed with diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve strict PN/LID separation, add a focused doctor or setup warning for rejected legacy LID-form allowlist entries, then rebase and validate the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member carrying the implementation and the follow-up corrections across the relevant WhatsApp surfaces.
